practiceQuestions.q: Who is widely regarded as the 'pioneer of modern Indian sculpture' and studied under artist Abanindranath Tagore?
practiceQuestions.sol: Devi Prasad Roy Choudhury was a prominent sculptor and painter who studied under Abanindranath Tagore and served as the principal of the Government College of Art and Craft, Madras. He is widely celebrated for monumental public sculptures like the 'Triumph of Labour'. [Primary Reference: NCERT Class 11 'An Introduction to Indian Art']

practiceQuestions.q: The famous open-air sculpture 'Santhal Family' at Santiniketan was created by which pioneering modern Indian sculptor?
practiceQuestions.sol: Ramkinkar Baij created 'Santhal Family' (1938) using cement and concrete over an armature of bamboo and wire at Santiniketan. It is considered India's first modern public sculpture. [Primary Reference: NCERT Class 11 'An Introduction to Indian Art']

practiceQuestions.q: Which material was predominantly used by Ramkinkar Baij for his dynamic, expressive sculptures, breaking away from conventional bronze and marble casting?
practiceQuestions.sol: Ramkinkar Baij pioneered the use of indigenous, accessible materials like cement, gravel, and concrete mixed together, allowing him to work directly in an open-air environment. [Primary Reference: NCERT Class 11 'An Introduction to Indian Art']

practiceQuestions.q: Where is the iconic monumental sculpture 'Triumph of Labour', depicting workers straining to move a rock, located?
opts: National Gallery of Modern Art, New Delhi
practiceQuestions.sol: D.P. Roy Choudhury's masterpiece 'Triumph of Labour' is prominently installed at Marina Beach in Chennai (and a replica at NGMA, New Delhi), celebrating the dignity and physical effort of ordinary laborers. [Primary Reference: NCERT Class 11 'An Introduction to Indian Art']
